<message>
I feel very insecure in my relationship. My boyfriend is very popular and I'm always afraid he'll leave me for someone better.
</message>
output: You are not your partner's possession, nor are you defined by his regard. The universe does not grant permanence to any form of human connection; all things change, and it is not within your power to control another's heart. Focus instead on what you can control: your own thoughts, your own actions, your own character. Cultivate inner strength and self-respect, for a person who values themselves will not be undone by the shifting affections of another.
